notes.title: Update 1.1 is live
notes.content:
While we are still working on our major update that will include the massive rock golem, a teleport/ dash movement system and a arena new map we've found some time to do a small update!

Here are the details:
[list]
[*]Added the frost sword, a two handed weapon that shoots three air blades. 
[*]Added the royal shield, a riot shield inspired design that provides a very effective defence at the cost of less visibility.   
[*]Fixed a few bugs including a bug that stop you progressing to a new wave. 
[*]Improved the highlight system.
[*]Other small tweaks.
[/list]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GTE4P57KLlc] The new weapons can be seen in action here[/url]

notes.title: Roadmap for new content
notes.content:
Here's a sneak peak of what we're working on:
[list]
[*]New weapons: The fire dagger, two-handed ice sword and the battle staff (some concept art below)
[*]New boss battle: Fight the deadly warlock at the peak of the mountain (concept art below)
[*]New enemy types: Rock golem, a massive hulking mobile artillery unit (concept art below)
[*]Balance changes: Expect some balancing of certain combinations of weapons. This will probably see the sword being nerfed slightly and the warglaives buffed.
[*]Local leaderboards: for playing with friends and family and comparing highscores
[*]Audio pass and improved spatilized audio for projectiles
[/list]
